label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey derived directly from java.util.Random.nextFloat() without cryptographic strengthening; this weak random value is stored in a session attribute and echoed in the HTTP response, enabling session fixation/forgery attacks. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-provided cookie value (param) concatenated into the response output at lines 111-116 without sanitization. Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities on their respective paths.
